text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume and those who work
with them
dream of winning the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crown and the glory that it
represents
captivates all those who
behold it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even those who once failed to achieve it
are
forever bound by its spell.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere here is more heated
than at the
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There are competitors today who didn't
run in the Satsuki Sho, including last
year's Best Junior-Year
racers, as well
as...
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because of the other ru...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clack... clack...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: May the best racer win.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Ardan. Yes, may the best racer
win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll see you out there.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Right. See you soon.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hi, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's have a great race today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. May we both finish with no
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: See you out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's two rivals, Mejiro Ardan
and
Sakura Chiyono O, leave promptly
after
exchanging brief greetings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As their footsteps fade into silence,
tension fills
the runners' tunnel. The air is
so ponderously thick, I can hardly
breathe, much less make a sound.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though their visit was brief,
the intensity
they
brought with them is suffocating.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Take deep breaths. You'll faint if you
keep
holding your breath like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're doing good. Breathe in... and
breathe
out...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not surprised you forgot to breathe
in this
intense atmosphere.
choice_data_list: I was holding my breath before I e...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I have experienced the same kind of
pressure in
the world of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
During major tournaments, where even the
possibility of losing cannot be
humored, everyone
exudes the same
aura.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
We must match their intensity if we're
not to be
cowed!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: With that, let us take to the battlefield!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (Chiyono O, Ardan...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(The three of us have walked side by
side down
the path of the Classic Triple
Crown tour...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Which is why I know exactly how much
the Derby
means to you two.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm prepared to wager my very life at the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And if I were to burn out, never to race
again, so
be it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'll let anyone have the
Japanese
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win it for Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But it's precisely because the three of us
have
pushed each other to become our
very best this
whole time...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That I want to beat you both!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let us test the depth of our resolve!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The glory of the Japanese Derby shall
be mine!
